title: AX-8 EVO Apex TC-5

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Built for aggressive dirt performance, the AGV AX-8 EVO Apex TC-5 is engineered for punishing motocross motos and technical single-track trails across punishing tracks and trails. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1267g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~97 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Ultra-light off-road helmet designed in collaboration with MotoGP riders.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for a snug, locked-in fit typical of motocross; features an intermediate oval head shape with aggressive cheek padding retention.

technical_analysis: Features 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance paired with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view. The interior utilizes 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the AGV AX-8 EVO Apex TC-5: combining Italy 🇮🇹 craftsmanship with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view and 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: AGV AX-8 EVO Apex TC-5: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the AGV AX-8 EVO Apex TC-5. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The AGV AX-8 EVO Apex TC-5 is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.

ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

introduction: Positioned in AGV's Dirt / MX lineup, the AX-8 EVO Apex TC-5 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The AGV AX-8 EVO Apex TC-5 represents AGV's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~97 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the AGV AX-8 EVO Apex TC-5 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
